newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 firms on strong major issue gains.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 firms on strong major issue gains.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index posted solid gains in thin trading on Tuesday led by major issues CEZ and Komercni Banka.
The PX50 rose by 1.1 percent to 547.6 and the RPIX index of continuously traded shares gained by the same amount to close at 1,137.

CEZ was the biggest major issue gainer rising 23 crowns, 2.3 percent, to 1,011 - the first time it has crossed the 1,000 mark since October last year. Dealers said that most of Tuesday's interest in CEZ came from domestic investors.
Komercni Banka, the most heavily capitalised banking stock on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) also rose sharply, posting a 50 crown, 2.2 percent, rise to 2,300.
"Komercni is still very cheap. Our analysts suggest to buy it," said Pavel Slanbor a dealer at Zivnostneska Banka.
SPT Telecom built on Monday's gains to post a 20 crown, 0.6 percent, rise to 3,420 and Ceska Sporitelna rose five crowns, 1.5 percent, to 328.
Among the less heavily capitalised shares, north Moravian brewery Radegast gained 42 crowns to 4,972.
On Tuesday, Radegast said that Britain's Bass Plc had raised its stake in the Moravian brewery to 30 percent from the 20 percent holding it acquired in July 1996.
Bass also holds a 51 percent stake in Prazske Pivovary which lost 123 crowns to 2,347.
